items.q: he turned out to be a good friend of mine because he couldn't stay out too late, but after rehearsal I'd take him to my house and we'd eat together

ctx.x: I remember Mac there, Mac Walker, the bass player I was telling you about, he turned out to be a good friend of mine because he couldn't stay out too late, but after rehearsal I'd take him to my house and we'd eat together, you know.
So he had some home life.
